mathematical_meanings: Left image: The outline is the circumference containing E, F and G. Right image: The hollow circle marks an omitted ordered pair on the purple curve.
Rationales: The feature traces the circumference of a geometric circle in the left image and marks an ordered pair excluded from the plotted trace in the right image. The large circular outline through E, F and G. The hollow circle on the purple curve at x = 1, below the filled point.
